scope: Interior cooling cell at representative point C, draft only. No central-point B replacement, optional stress activation, full plate or manifold.

implementation_support.point_C: 45 C inlet, 1400 W interface heat, 2.8 L/min total footprint flow, 30 kPa cell allocation; representative sourced operating point, not a new adopted population
implementation_support.geometry: Channel width/fin width 0.2-0.5 mm, depth 1-3 mm; fixed 30 mm footprint/length, 1 mm plate base and 0.5 mm cold-plate cover
implementation_support.buyer_interface: 85 C lid-side TIM2 case plane; vapour-chamber post-spreader map, TIM2 resistance and uncertainty require matched buyer input. Plate cover is not the vapour lid.
implementation_support.declared: PG25 fluid 30-99 C, laminar Reynolds <=2000, checked at reference extrema
implementation_support.reference_simplification: Steady conjugate laminar route: variable rho/mu/k but cp held at inlet in the reference. variable-cp is diagnostic, not the current reference.
implementation_support.heat_map: Existing axial map is transverse-uniform; no general 2D hotspot/spreader claim without an adopted map contract

validity.decision_needed: Science confirms point-C/map/TIM2 applicability and bounds the cp-held and other simplifications separately from numerical residuals

legacy_peak_profile_pressure.note: peak_c/profile_c/pressure_drop_pa; not co-located lid-side TIM2 temperature

case_faces.note: Co-located x/y/area/plate temperature and post-spreader heat-flux samples

peak_case_c_interval.note: Computed on matched faces as max(T_plate + R_TIM2*q_local), with map/numerical uncertainty

mass_flux_in_out.note: Signed surface integrals with normals and density convention, not prescribed input flow alone

enthalpy_and_boundary_flux.note: Reference bookkeeping exists; prospective contract must retain independent integrals and the pinned cp-held convention

solid_fluid_interface_flux.note: Matched normal flux and temperatures on both sides

temperature_extrema_field.note: Fluid/solid extrema and actual field sampling, not just model peak/profile

cell_pressure_flow_power.note: Delta p in Pa, actual cell/half-cell flow in m3/s and hydraulic power on the same basis; footprint flow is not half-cell flow

laws.statement: Sum of outward signed mass-flow surface integrals is zero
laws.conditions: No mass source, steady closed accounting surface; use actual pinned density and normals
laws.calibration: Absolute kg/s and relative mass closure, independently integrated at matched inlet/outlet planes

laws.statement: Imposed interface heat equals net outward fluid enthalpy plus other retained boundary energy fluxes
laws.conditions: Steady solid+fluid volume, exact reference energy convention, account for any retained mechanical terms; internal flux cancels
laws.calibration: Watts closure with mesh/iteration refinement; derived outlet T from input heat is not independent closure; cp-held physical discrepancy needs separate review

laws.statement: Matched interface temperatures agree and outward heat fluxes cancel
laws.conditions: Perfect solid-fluid coupling in pinned reference; keep TIM2 as a separate contact law
laws.calibration: Paired face traces and area-weighted normal flux with non-conformal interpolation uncertainty

laws.conditions: Approved areal contact resistance in m2*K/W, co-located post-spreader flux in W/m2, no hidden redistribution in TIM2
laws.calibration: Matched-point K residual and maximum-location check; never add maxima from different locations; map uncertainty is separate

laws.statement: Temperature is not below inlet temperature
laws.conditions: Nonnegative heat input, passive insulated exterior, no other colder sink, positive conductivity and approved steady advective-diffusive scope
laws.calibration: Registered field minima and refined undershoot; no arbitrary 85 C physics-law ceiling

laws.statement: Hydraulic power = Delta p * Q on the same cell basis
laws.conditions: Pascal pressure difference and m3/s flow; compare like static-head/area stations; pump input/electrical efficiency is not claimed
laws.calibration: Unit/convention verification, footprint-to-half-cell mapping and pressure observer refinement

laws.statement: Reflection across the declared transverse symmetry plane leaves temperature/flow unchanged and normal flux zero
laws.conditions: Transverse-uniform buyer map and identical reflected boundary data; no inlet/outlet reversal invariance
laws.calibration: Mirrored face/field witnesses or zero-normal-flux trace with mesh symmetry error

laws.statement: With zero heat and no other thermal source/sink, temperature equals inlet temperature
laws.conditions: Separate analytic verification control; finite supported flow, no dissipation term absent from pinned energy model
laws.calibration: Uniform-temperature residual; control outside the point-C buyer question

excluded_claims: No universal peak-temperature monotonicity versus flow or geometry with changing heat maps, variable properties or flow linked to power; any matched-pair tendency is diagnostic until separately justified.
No finite-temperature zero-flow limit at nonzero power, and no inlet/outlet-reversal symmetry under advection.
No die/junction or full-plate performance claim; the 85 C limit is the lid-side TIM2 case plane.
Do not demand variable-cp closure from the cp-held reference or call reference simplification error a candidate failure.

tolerances.recipe: Common README plan; numerical residuals plus separately reviewed map/TIM2 and physical-simplification uncertainty

calibration.image_basis: Pinned OpenCFD image in cooling verification draft; code verification SPECIFIED_NOT_RUN, not accepted by this contract
holds: Exact-image code verification: Poiseuille, energy MMS, layered conduction
Declared point-C post-spreader map/TIM2 and uncertainty

probes.proposal: Point-C supported geometries, Re/property-edge checks, matched mirror pairs and separately labelled analytic controls; no jobs authorised

review_owner: Carbon Validator and science; point-C use and owner adoption remain reserved
